parts.text: Morija Museum and Archives stands at the base of Makhoarane Mountain in Morija, about 45 km south of Maseru. It was formally established in 1956, with roots in the work of French Protestant missionaries placed there by Moshoeshoe. The archives and museum were united in 1989.
